data.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
data.description: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.
